name: migrate_logger
description: Migrates every .js file in a directory from log(level, ...args) to logger.<level>(...args), updates the logger import and renames formatId to formatID. Rewrites files in place; returns counts and files with leftover problems.
whenToUse: For the logger API migration of a directory of modules (e.g. src/modules); reusable for further directories.

dir.description: Directory relative to the project root

provenance.reason: bulk logger migration of 24 modules, more directories later
